name: @bridge/helpdesk
description: Helpdesk capability package (P2, ADR-018/ADR-021): Help Request entity flow — a request routed over the workspace graph (capability-routing) and an answer staged as a governed draft (offer-drafting). Pure logic only, no store — persistence stays in @bridge/db's helpdesk-store; governance stays in the pipeline (apps/api routes stageAnswer through pipeline.propose). package.yaml at this root is the installable-package manifest packages.register parses.
